name: PhyGround
summary: 通过文本、首帧和生成视频评测生成式世界模型物理合理性的基准。
summaryEn: A benchmark evaluating physical plausibility in generative world models using prompts, first frames, and generated videos.
organizationsZh: 西北大学世界模型团队
access: Prompts and first images available on Hugging Face
accessZh: 提示和首帧图像已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 面向生成式世界模型物理落地性的专项诊断基准
verdictEn: A targeted diagnostic benchmark for physical grounding in generative world models
wmNote: 固定初态和文本条件便于比较不同视频世界模型的物理演化。
wmNoteEn: Fixed initial states and prompts enable comparison of physical evolution across video world models.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2605.10806] PhyGround: Benchmarking Physical Reasoning in Generative World Models
evidence.statement: Expected physical outcomes and law-specific questions evaluate generative world models across 250 prompts.
